button.adaptation: A restrained editorial action with a literal destination or verb; it should not interrupt reading.
button.notes: Inspect the candidate anatomy and props before adapting; this guidance does not describe its current API.

card.adaptation: An article or index entry with a title, image, deck, and real metadata when available.
card.notes: No standalone card atom is assumed; compose semantic HTML with existing atoms.

input.adaptation: A clearly labeled reading-width field; errors appear with explanatory text below it.
input.notes: Inspect the candidate anatomy and props before adapting; this guidance does not describe its current API.

navbar.adaptation: A masthead plus real sections or tasks, with a plain current-section indicator.
navbar.notes: MenuVertical is a reference for a navigation list, not a compact header. Its large type and moving labels require replacement for this navbar direction.

hero.adaptation: A cover composition: title, standfirst, one meaningful image, and a route into the content.
hero.notes: Compose the specified section with semantic HTML, a figure, and existing Button. No exact hero match is assumed; Hero307 includes a dashboard composition that does not fit this direction.

pricing.adaptation: Membership or service choices presented as an understandable comparison with exclusions visible.
pricing.notes: Inspect the candidate anatomy and props before adapting; this guidance does not describe its current API.
